title: Easier Dyes!
description: Get dyes even faster in the early game.
body:
This Data Pack creates recipes that make dyes easier to obtain early on (with the exception of purple).

**The following recipes have been added:**
- _Black Dye:_ Most music discs can be turned into black dye. Charcoal can also be used to turn into black dye.
- _Green Dye:_ Any type of leaf block can be turned into green dye.
- _Brown Dye:_ Adding oak logs and a water bucket can be turned into 3 brown dyes.
- _Purple Dye:_ Chorus fruit can be turned into purple dye.


_**This Data Pack is compatible with Minecraft version 1.21 and higher.**_
